title: I’ve noticed that at least at a certain level the dream content seems to be an almost perfect reflection of my current state of mind and train of thought.

classification.theory_summary: Dream content shifts in response to the dreamer's moment-to-moment positivity/negativity; one example of an 'evil/demonic' dimension shifting back to neutral/positive after the dreamer stopped engaging with negativity; notes some 'mallworldy' dreams may have outside sources of content generation.

meta.author_theory: Dream content mirrors current state of mind; an 'evil/demonic' realm can shift back to neutral/positive when the dreamer stops feeding negativity; some intense 'mallworldy' dreams may include outside sources of content generation.

qualities.raw_description: “down in one of these evil/demonic seeming dimensions”

interactions.description: Dreamer recognizes what is going on in an “evil/demonic seeming” dimension, stops feeding negativity into it, and the experience gradually shifts back to relatively neutral/positive before waking up.
Dreamer is able to wake up after the experience shifts back to a relatively neutral to positive experience.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily theoretical; only one concrete phenomenological episode is described (“down in… evil/demonic… dimension” that gradually shifts to neutral/positive and then waking). No specific Mall World locations (mall/school/hotel) or layout details are provided.
